Their features emphasize necromancy, Spare the Dying, resistance against disease, undead hesitation, survival without breath or sustenance, aging resistance, self-healing, limb reattachment, and undead-related durability.
mechanical_tags: advantage on saving throws against disease
undead have difficulty targeting the warlock
regain hit points after death saving throw success or Spare the Dying use
no food, water, or sleep required
build_notes: Undead, death, and self healing are defining because the subclass is focused on surviving death and learning from undying patrons.
Cantrips are included because the subclass grants Spare the Dying, but the allowed trait list has no valid 'spare the dying' trait.
The mechanical_tags preserve details that do not map cleanly to ALLOWED_TRAITS.
review_reasons: The allowed trait list has no direct trait for disease resistance, aging resistance, not needing food or sleep, or Spare the Dying.
Several defining survival mechanics are therefore represented in mechanical_tags rather than traits.

name: Wizard
summary: Wizards are Intelligence-based arcane full casters who learn, prepare, copy, and recover spells through study and spellbooks. Their core mechanics emphasize ritual casting, prepared spellcasting, Arcane Recovery, Spell Mastery, Signature Spells, and broad access to arcane spell schools.
build_notes: The class is primarily an Intelligence-based arcane full caster.
Spellbook preparation, ritual casting, and broad spell access define the class more than any single damage type or role.
The base class supports blasting, control, defense, utility, and summoning through spell selection, but those roles should be weighted below the core spellcasting identity.

name: School of Abjuration
summary: Abjuration wizards specialize in protective magic that blocks, banishes, and wards. Their features emphasize cheaper abjuration spell copying, a protective Arcane Ward, projected ally protection, stronger Counterspell and Dispel Magic checks, and resistance to spell damage.
mechanical_tags: proficiency bonus to Counterspell and Dispel Magic checks
build_notes: Abjuration and warding are defining because every subclass feature improves protective magic.
Protect allies is strongly supported by Projected Ward.
Anti-mage is meaningful because Improved Abjuration directly improves Counterspell and Dispel Magic checks.

name: School of Bladesinging
summary: Bladesingers blend wizard magic with elegant melee combat, speed, defense, and song-like martial technique. Their features emphasize light armor, one-handed melee weapons, Performance or Acrobatics, Bladesong, improved armor class, concentration support, speed, Extra Attack, damage reduction through spell slots, and melee damage bonuses.
mechanical_tags: reduce damage by expending spell slot
build_notes: Melee spellcaster is defining because the subclass explicitly combines wizard spellcasting with weapon combat.
High armor class and defensive fighting are central through Bladesong and Song of Defense.
Dexterity is important because the subclass uses light armor, one-handed weapons, Acrobatics, and melee defense.

name: School of Chronurgy
summary: Chronurgy wizards manipulate time through dunamis magic, bending outcomes, freezing creatures in temporal stasis, storing spells in motes, and forcing rolls to succeed or fail. Their features emphasize initiative, rerolls, incapacitation, speed suppression, spell storage, and powerful roll control.
build_notes: Time magic is defining because every subclass feature manipulates timing, outcomes, or temporal stasis.
Controller and support are both strongly supported by Momentary Stasis, Arcane Abeyance, and Convergent Future.
Exhaustion is included because Convergent Future explicitly imposes exhaustion on use.

name: School of Conjuration
summary: Conjuration wizards specialize in producing objects, creatures, and movement through magic. Their features emphasize cheaper conjuration spell copying, minor object creation, teleportation, concentration support for conjuration spells, and stronger summoned creatures.
mechanical_tags: concentration cannot be broken by damage for conjuration spells
temporary hit points for summoned or created creatures
build_notes: Conjuration, summoning, and teleportation are defining because every subclass feature supports creating, summoning, or repositioning.
Concentration is meaningful because Focused Conjuration protects concentration on conjuration spells.
Temporary hit points are included because Durable Summons grants them to summoned or created creatures.

name: School of Divination
summary: Divination wizards specialize in sight, foresight, remote perception, and manipulating fate. Their features emphasize cheaper divination spell copying, replacing d20 rolls through Portent, recovering spell slots after divination spells, enhanced perception options, and three Portent dice.
mechanical_tags: replace attack roll, saving throw, or ability check
recover spell slot after divination spell
build_notes: Divination is defining because the subclass is entirely built around foresight and magical perception.
Support, buffing, and debuffing are strongly supported by Portent replacing important rolls.
Perception and invisibility are meaningful through The Third Eye options.

name: School of Enchantment
summary: Enchantment wizards specialize in magically influencing and manipulating other minds. Their features emphasize cheaper enchantment spell copying, charm, incapacitation through hypnotic gaze, defensive attack redirection, split-target enchantment spells, and memory alteration.
mechanical_tags: target a second creature with enchantment spell
make target unaware of being charmed
build_notes: Enchantment, charm, and mind control are defining because every feature manipulates attention, behavior, or memory.
Controller is strongly supported by Hypnotic Gaze and Split Enchantment.
Redirect damage is meaningful because Instinctive Charm can redirect an incoming attack.

name: School of Evocation
summary: Evocation wizards specialize in elemental and destructive magical energy. Their features emphasize cheaper evocation spell copying, sculpting area spells around allies, stronger cantrips, Intelligence-added evocation damage, maximized spell damage, and overchanneling damage at personal cost.
mechanical_tags: protect creatures from evocation area spells
build_notes: Blaster and area damage are defining because the subclass is built around damaging evocation spells.
Protect allies is meaningful because Sculpt Spells lets allies avoid evocation area damage.
Specific damage types are weighted moderately because evocation covers many damage spells rather than a single fixed element.

name: School of Graviturgy
summary: Graviturgy wizards manipulate gravity through dunamis magic, changing creature and object weight, moving targets, improving falls and jumps, restraining enemies in gravity wells, and protecting themselves by redirecting attacks. Their features emphasize forced movement, mobility, control, damage, and battlefield positioning.
mechanical_tags: increase or decrease object or creature weight
disadvantage on Strength checks and saves
move target after spell hit or failed save
build_notes: Gravity magic, battlefield control, and forced movement are defining because the subclass manipulates weight, movement, and positioning.
Restrained is strongly supported by Event Horizon.
Buffing is secondary because Adjust Density can help movement and jumping, but the subclass is mostly control-oriented.

name: School of Illusion
summary: Illusion wizards specialize in deceptive sensory magic, improving illusions, reshaping them after casting, briefly making illusory objects real, and using illusion to avoid harm. Their features emphasize Minor Illusion, flexible illusion manipulation, concealment, misdirection, and defensive fake duplicates.
mechanical_tags: sound and image with same casting
make one inanimate nonmagical illusion object real
build_notes: Illusion is defining because every subclass feature modifies illusion magic.
Utility caster is strongly supported by Malleable Illusions and Illusory Reality.
Damage reduction is included because Illusory Self can cause an attack to miss.

name: School of Necromancy
summary: Necromancy wizards study life force, death, undeath, and the animation of corpses. Their features emphasize cheaper necromancy spell copying, self-healing from killing creatures with spells, stronger undead minions, necrotic resistance, hit point maximum protection, and control over undead creatures.
mechanical_tags: regain hit points after killing with spell
hit point maximum cannot be reduced
visual_or_flavor_tags: cosmic forces of life and death
build_notes: Necromancy, death, undead, and necrotic are defining because every feature reinforces undead creation, life-force manipulation, or necrotic durability.
Summoning is meaningful because Undead Thralls improves Animate Dead and undead minions.
Self healing is strongly supported by Grim Harvest.

name: Order of Scribes
summary: Order of Scribes wizards awaken their spellbooks and use magical scholarship to alter spell damage, copy spells quickly, cast rituals faster, manifest a spectral mind, cast through that mind, create scrolls, reduce damage by sacrificing spells, and restore the spellbook.
mechanical_tags: cast wizard spell from spectral mind's space
damage negation by dismissing Manifest Mind
build_notes: Scholar, spellcasting, ritual casting, and scrolls are defining because the subclass centers on the spellbook as an awakened magical tool.
Damage type traits are moderate because Awakened Spellbook can change spell damage types based on spells in the book, but no single damage type defines the subclass.
Damage reduction is meaningful through One with the Word.

name: School of Transmutation
summary: Transmutation wizards specialize in changing matter, creatures, and physical properties. Their features emphasize cheaper transmutation spell copying, minor material transformation, a transmuter's stone granting utility benefits, shapechanging, restoration, curse removal, healing, revival, age alteration, and transformation into beasts.
build_notes: Transmutation and shapechanging are defining because the subclass changes materials, bodies, and forms.
Healing and revival are significant at high level through Master Transmuter options.
Damage resistance, speed, and Constitution saves are meaningful because they are Transmuter's Stone choices rather than always simultaneous.

name: School of War Magic
summary: War Magic wizards blend evocation and abjuration for battlefield survival and tactical spell combat. Their features emphasize reaction-based armor class or saving throw bonuses, initiative from Intelligence, storing power after Counterspell and Dispel Magic, concentration-based defensive bonuses, and force damage retaliation when ending a magical reserve.
mechanical_tags: gain power after Counterspell or Dispel Magic
AC and saving throw bonus while concentrating
force damage to nearby creatures after Arcane Deflection
build_notes: Saving throw bonus, reaction, and defensive fighting are defining because Arcane Deflection is the core early feature.
Initiative bonus is important through Tactical Wit.
Force damage and anti-mage traits are supported by Power Surge and its interaction with Counterspell and Dispel Magic.
